description: This Java class 'DittoTrustManagerFactory' extends 'TrustManagerFactory' to create a customized factory that wraps trust managers in 'DittoTrustManager' instances and delegates all other method calls. It is used for SSL trust management with added logging and connection-specific behavior, likely for secure communication within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: DittoTrustManagerFactory
classes.description: A specialized TrustManagerFactory that wraps trust managers in 'DittoTrustManager' instances for enhanced SSL trust management specific to the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DittoTrustManagerFactory for a given Connection and ConnectionLogger, initializing internal trust manager factories with connection-specific parameters.

methods.name: DittoTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with delegate trust manager factories, a hostname, and a connection logger, employing an anonymous TrustManagerFactorySpi to delegate method calls.
